item: Path tokens in written addresses masked by shape (R736); sample-zip address columns (row 104); wider report-row ratchet (row 106)
key_paths: src/database/address_mask.py src/database/feed_key.py src/api/diagnostics/source_samples.py src/api/diagnostics/__init__.py tests/test_address_path_mask_r736.py tests/test_address_mask_r734.py tests/test_source_samples.py docs/ledger/RULINGS_INDEX.md
summary: R734's one helper now also masks the path: a path parameter's value always; a segment that is or holds a UUID, a 16+ hex run or a 24+ base64url token with a letter and a digit not shaped like lower-case words (a JWT, standard base64, a token after a prefix or between , @ : = . ~ or a backslash included), a short extension kept. A feed key's path opening with // stays a path. 4 of 5,692 catalogue feed addresses change. Stated limit: by shape, so an unusual short token can still appear. The source-samples zip writes every column but the body through reported_url, JSON text included. The report-row ratchet reads src/catalog, src/ingest, dict() calls and row[key] assignments. Two security reads; one must-fix fixed.
